notes: Pricing is per user. Both billing variants are displayed: Basic $10/user/mo billed annually ($120/yr) or $12 billed monthly; Premium $17/user/mo billed annually ($200/yr) or $20 billed monthly. Prices are shown with '$' only; USD is the natural reading but is not written on the page. No free plan card is displayed: the FAQ says you can sign up, connect calendars and use meeting polls for free, but booking from links needs Basic or Premium, so no Free plan is expected and pricing_status was left out (paid vs freemium is ambiguous). The 25% student/non-profit discount and >50-user volume pricing are not plans. Fastmail calendars, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams links, and Claude/ChatGPT via MCP are also stated; only 6 integrations are listed. Forbidden texts are the sample chat prompts shown in the AI-assistant demo mock-ups (instruction-like text aimed at an AI assistant); they must not be reported as facts. Demo names (Noah Wilson, Mara Okafor, Acme) are fictional UI mock-ups. 'Join over 2,000 happy customers' is a company-stated count, not payment proof. 'SavvyCal, Inc.' does not state a country or city; no founding year or team size is stated.
